title: connector fetch request, v0
description: POST /v0/contributions/connector/fetch, since Plugin API 0.3. Fetch one page of new or changed source items after the checkpoint. The plugin is stateless between invocations: the core persists the checkpoint and advances it only after the page's items are durably accepted.

invocation_id.description: Unique per attempt; correlate logs with it.

configuration.description: The plugin configuration the installer supplies, valid against configuration.schema.

connector.description: The Connector Instance the core invokes the plugin for.

config.description: The Connector Instance configuration, already valid against the kind's config_schema.

credential.description: The decrypted Deposited Credential, valid against the kind's credential_schema; null for a kind without one. Sent only for this invocation: never log, echo or persist it.

checkpoint.description: The opaque Acquisition Checkpoint the plugin returned last (any JSON value); null on the first run of a Connector Instance.

now.description: The core's clock for this invocation (RFC 3339, UTC). Use it instead of the local clock so runs are reproducible.

page_in_run.description: 0 for the first page of a run, then counts up while the plugin answers more: true.

reads_today.description: Source resources read during the current UTC day, including earlier pages of this run, for sources that bill or rate-limit per resource.
